additional_info.subject: RE: AW: AW: ID0448976-DC/Si-D/DE[NULL] charging station defective CRM:02678000372
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Paul,
Thank you for the prompt feedback! I am taking a look at charger
MP / R6 170002087
that you mentioned, and especially its behavior yesterday morning.
I believe I identified the issue. In our Sicharge D, if an OCPP Backend is configured, it is always necessary to perform an authorization process between Backend and charger, even when the "authorization" is not configured. This means that, if authorization is not configured, as in your charger, the charger will send anyway a StartTransaction command to the Backend, with an empty "IDTag". This is exactly what is happening in you case:
Charger is connected to REEV Backend
Authorization is disabled
Everytime a session is starting the charger sends a "StratTransaction" command with an empty "IDTag".
However, these transactions are blocked by the Backend, and that is the reason why it was not possible to perform any charging session:
Therefore, in order to overcome the situation, it is necessary to have the OCPP Backend accept an "empty IDTag". In this way, it will be possible to charge with a Backend connected and without authorization configured.
I also noticed that yesterday, after a reboot was launched at 2025-09-15T11:40:49 UTC time, the charger lost the connection to the OCPP Backend.
I remotely logged in the charger via SSH, I checked the router and saw that the router does not recognize any SIM.
Please confirm to me if the SIM has been removed, otherwise the router cannot read the SIM anymore.
Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: AW: AW: ID0448976-DC/Si-D/DE[NULL] charging station defective CRM:02678000372
additional_info.body:
Hallo Herr Bittner
Ohne Backend werden Sie keine Daten bekommen das stimmt, dann können sie gleich auf kostenlos stellen und einfach laden. Wenn sie jedoch mit invalid IDs laden möchten dann müssen Sie die config ändern im folgenden Parameter
},
"StopTransactionOnInvalidId": {
"readonly": false,
"value": true
},
das ist ein auszug aus Ihrem Lader (das ist die abgespeicherte Konfig die nur vom Backend beschrieben werden kann) Bitte ändern sie diesen Parameter auf False dann sollten auch "Leere" IDs unktionieren.
Das wird alles im OCPP 1,6 beschrieben bitte gehen sich danach vor.
